title: CIS Synthetic Windows Server Benchmark
description: Settings for Synthetic Windows Server, domain controllers and member servers.

profile_definitions.title: Level 1 - Domain Controller
profile_definitions.description: Settings a domain controller can take with little effect on the services it runs.

profile_definitions.title: Level 1 - Member Server
profile_definitions.description: Settings a member server can take with little effect on the services it runs.

profile_definitions.title: Level 2 - Domain Controller
profile_definitions.description: Stricter settings for domain controllers; includes Level 1 - Domain Controller.

profile_definitions.title: Level 2 - Member Server
profile_definitions.description: Stricter settings for member servers; includes Level 1 - Member Server.

profile_definitions.title: Next Generation Security - Domain Controller
profile_definitions.description: Settings that need recent hardware security features on a domain controller.

profile_definitions.title: Next Generation Security - Member Server
profile_definitions.description: Settings that need recent hardware security features on a member server.

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Password history length' is at least '24 passwords'

cis_controls.title: Give every account its own password

recommendations.description: How many of an account's earlier passwords it may not use again.
recommendations.rationale: Without a history, a forced change ends with the old password back in place.
recommendations.impact: People need a fresh password at each change, and some will write it down.
recommendations.audit:
Open the Synthetic Policy Editor and read the value at:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Passwords\History length
```
recommendations.remediation:
Set this policy path to `24`:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Passwords\History length
```
recommendations.default_value: 24 on domain members; 0 on servers outside a domain.

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Shortest allowed password' is at least '14 characters'

cis_controls.title: Give every account its own password

recommendations.description: The fewest characters a new password may have.
recommendations.rationale: Every extra character multiplies the work of guessing.
recommendations.impact: Shorter passwords already set keep working until they are next changed.
recommendations.audit:
Open the Synthetic Policy Editor and read the value at:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Passwords\Shortest allowed
```
recommendations.remediation:
Set this policy path to `14`:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Passwords\Shortest allowed
```
recommendations.default_value: 7 on domain members; 0 on servers outside a domain.

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Failed sign-ins before lock' is between '1 and 5'
recommendations.description: How many wrong passwords in a row lock the account. `0` turns locking off.
recommendations.rationale: Locking stops someone trying password after password at the sign-in prompt.
recommendations.impact: Someone who knows account names can lock them deliberately; pair this with a short lock duration.
recommendations.audit:
Open the Synthetic Policy Editor and read the value at:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Lockout\Failed sign-ins before lock
```
recommendations.remediation:
Set this policy path to `5`:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Lockout\Failed sign-ins before lock
```

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Visitor account' is set to 'Off' (member servers only)
recommendations.description: Whether the built-in Visitor account can sign in.
recommendations.rationale: The Visitor account often has no password at all.
recommendations.impact: None: servers do not use it.
recommendations.audit:
The value must be `0`. Read it from the registry:

```
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Synthetic\Accounts\Visitor:Enabled
```
recommendations.remediation:
Set this policy path to `Off`:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Accounts\Visitor account
```

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Packet filter (domain networks)' is set to 'On'

cis_controls.title: Filter traffic at each end-user device

recommendations.description: Whether the built-in packet filter runs while the server is on a domain network.
recommendations.rationale: With the filter off, every listening service takes connections from anywhere.
recommendations.impact: An application that waits for connections needs a filter rule before anyone can reach it.
recommendations.audit:
The value must be `1`. Read it from the registry:

```
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Synthetic\PacketFilter\Domain:Enabled
```
recommendations.remediation:
Set this policy path to `On`:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Packet Filter\Domain networks\State
```

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Record credential checks' is set to 'Passes and failures'
recommendations.description: Writes an event each time a name and password are checked, locally or against the domain.
recommendations.rationale: A run of failed checks is the earliest sign of someone guessing passwords.
recommendations.impact: The security log fills faster; give it more room.
recommendations.remediation:
Set this policy path to `Passes and failures`:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Event Recording\Sign-in\Credential checks
```

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Legacy TLS 1.0 listener' is set to 'Off'

cis_controls.title: Encrypt sensitive data on the wire

recommendations.description: Whether the server still answers TLS 1.0 connections.
recommendations.rationale: TLS 1.0 has known weaknesses and newer versions replace it.
recommendations.impact: Clients that speak only TLS 1.0 are turned away.
recommendations.audit:
The value must be `0`. Read it from the registry:

```
HKLM\SYSTEM\Synthetic\Crypto\Protocols\TLS 1.0\Listener:Enabled
```

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Remote session drive mapping' is set to 'Blocked'
recommendations.description: Whether a remote session can attach the client's local drives.
recommendations.rationale: An attached drive moves files between the client and the server around any transfer controls.
recommendations.impact: People move files through an approved share instead.
recommendations.audit:
The value must be `1`. Read it from the registry:

```
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Synthetic\RemoteSessions:BlockDriveMapping
```
recommendations.remediation:
Set this policy path to `Blocked`:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Remote Sessions\Devices\Drive mapping
```

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Remote session RPC encryption' is set to 'Required'

cis_controls.title: Encrypt sensitive data on the wire

recommendations.description: Whether the remote session host takes only signed and encrypted RPC calls.
recommendations.rationale: Calls without both can be read on the way or sent again by someone else.
recommendations.audit:
The value must be `1`. Read it from the registry:

```
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Synthetic\RemoteSessions:RequireEncryptedRpc
```
recommendations.remediation:
Set this policy path to `Required`:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Remote Sessions\Security\RPC encryption
```

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Lock screen after idle' is set to 'On, with password'
recommendations.description: Whether an idle session locks and asks for the password to come back.
recommendations.rationale: A console left signed in is open to whoever walks past.
recommendations.audit:
The value must be `1`. Read it from the registry:

```
HKU\[USER SID]\Software\Policies\Synthetic\Desktop:LockWithPassword
```
recommendations.remediation:
Set this policy path to `On, with password`:

```
User Policy\Desktop\Lock screen after idle
```

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Network sign-in rights' lists only 'Administrators, Signed-in Users'
recommendations.description: Which accounts may reach the server over the network.
recommendations.rationale: Taking out broad groups such as Anyone narrows who can reach shares and services.
recommendations.impact: Services that connect as other accounts need those accounts added; check before applying.
recommendations.audit:
Open the Synthetic Policy Editor and read the value at:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Rights\Network sign-in
```

Compare the list with the accounts the server's services use.
recommendations.remediation:
Set this policy path to `Administrators, Signed-in Users`:

```
Machine Policy\Security\Rights\Network sign-in
```
